_about: Competitive sets the planner offers under 'Competitive sets'. Taken from the PokeMMO StratDex (mmoshowdown.com, PokeMMO's own Showdown tiers), read 2026-11-21.

basis: 'set' = a set written on the StratDex page (verified: true); 'usage' = built from the page's PokeMMO Showdown usage stats (most used nature, ability, item, moves, EVs) where no set is written yet (verified: false until someone checks it).
source: the StratDex page the set comes from. Sets you add yourself: verified false until checked.
ivs: a stat left out = don't care; 31 = must be 31; 0 = must be 0 (Trick Room 0 Spe, Gyro Ball). Stats: HP, Atk, Def, SpA, SpD, Spe.
eggMoves: only moves the planner must breed in (egg moves of the line in species.json that the line can't learn by level-up, TM or tutor). moves: the whole moveset, shown as information.
item: shown as information; when it is one of the planner's TMs and held items it is added to the cost.
test/presets.test.js checks every set against species.json (species, nature, ability, egg moves).
